coverage_notes: Every supplied observation and CSV row was reviewed. Every registered anchor page, including secondary locations, was actually viewed. This is alignment of the exact supplied registry, not a full-paper census or proof of the source presentation used by the original curators. All inputs are unchanged.
shared_qualifications: Source Table 1 analyses (PDF p.2) independently identifyFe-24Cr andFe-24Cr-11Mo. All experiments are at65 C, not CRA25 C. Source polarization curves use potential steps with current read after400 s; PL/PH surface-analysis exposures are one-hour holds at200/500 mV versus normal hydrogen electrode.

All eight supplied observations are no-pitting lower limits from the explicit interpretation of the Fig.3 current-time transients (PDF p.6). The imposed PL/PH endpoints are not measured onsets. Candidate rows share material/electrolyte, but their numerical CRA Epit values have no established identity with these hold bounds.

The source normal-hydrogen reference and CRA SCE reference require electrode calibration/temperature for a definitive offset. No offset is fitted to CRA and no numerical comparison is claimed. More fundamentally, converting units would not make a no-pitting hold endpoint an observed threshold.

Source Fe-Cr may exhibit pitting in electrolyteB during the separate polarization experiment, yet the source explicitly excludes pitting at the registered PL/PH holds. Those distinct statements are both retained; no new threshold is extracted from an unannotated continuous curve.
